card.title: Ozone layer depletion: causes, effects and control measures

rows.label: Concept
rows.text: The ozone story is a catalytic horror story with a happy regulatory ending. CFCs — prized precisely for their inertness — ride to the stratosphere where UV cracks their C–Cl bonds; the freed **Cl•** strips ozone (Cl• + O₃ → ClO• + O₂) and is **regenerated** by ClO• + O → Cl• + O₂, so each atom destroys ~100,000 ozone molecules — net O₃ + O → 2O₂. Halons' bromine is ~45× worse per atom; N₂O runs an NO• cousin cycle.…

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: ***The September hole*** — every Antarctic spring the same sequence replays: dark winter clouds bank Cl₂, the sun returns, and the column ozone collapses below 100 DU within weeks.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Cycle pair: Cl. + O3 -> ClO. + O2 then ClO. + O -> Cl. + O2. One Cl = ~100,000 O3. Hole recipe: winter PSCs + spring light. Treaty chain: Montreal 1987 -> Kigali 2016. ODP: CFC 1.0, HCFC 0.05, HFC 0.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: **NEB-style (3m): What are CFCs? Explain, with equations, how they deplete the ozone layer.** — **CFCs (chlorofluorocarbons or freons)** — compounds such as CFCl₃ (freon-11) and CF₂Cl₂ (freon-12) in which hydrogen of the alkane is fully replaced by chlorine and fluorine — were widely used as refrigerants, aerosol propellants,…  ·  **NEB-style (2m): State three harmful effects of ozone depletion and two measures to control it.** — **Effects:** (1) **Human health:** increased UV-B at the surface raises the incidence of skin cancers (including malignant melanoma), eye cataracts and suppression of the immune system.…

rows.label: Hints
rows.text: Always write both cycle steps and the word "regenerated" — the catalytic nature is the analytical mark; a single equation answer caps at half.

rows.label: Quick concepts
rows.text: One radical, one hundred thousand victims: the catalytic cycle's regeneration step (ClO• + O → Cl• + O₂) is the entire reason a few thousand tonnes of CFC chlorine could thin a planetary shield.

rows.label: Key points
rows.text: Natural balance: O2 + UV -> 2O; O + O2 -> O3 vs O3 + UV -> O2 + O; steady ~300 DU. Cause: CFCs (CFCl3, CF2Cl2) inert below, UV splits C-Cl: CFCl3 + UV -> CFCl2. + Cl.; cycle: Cl. + O3 -> ClO. + O2; ClO. + O -> Cl. + O2; net O3 + O -> 2O2 - Cl regenerated, one Cl kills ~100,000 O3.…

rows.label: Universal facts
rows.text: The Montreal Protocol is the only treaty ratified by every UN member state — and the 2016 Kigali Amendment extended it to HFCs for their climate effect.

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: ❌ Mitosis produces genetically different cells. ✅ Mitosis produces genetically identical diploid daughter cells.  ·  ❌ Meiosis produces identical cells. ✅ Meiosis produces 4 genetically diverse haploid gametes.  ·  ❌ Crossing over occurs in mitosis. ✅ Crossing over occurs in Prophase I of meiosis only.

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: ❌ All enzymes are proteins. ✅ Most enzymes are proteins; some RNA molecules (ribozymes) also have catalytic activity.  ·  ❌ ATP is the only energy currency. ✅ GTP, UTP, and CTP also serve as energy carriers in specific pathways.  ·  ❌ Photosynthesis occurs in all plant cells. ✅ Photosynthesis occurs only in cells containing chloroplasts (mainly mesophyll).

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: ❌ Respiration and photosynthesis are opposite processes with same equation. ✅ They are complementary but occur in different organelles and under different conditions.  ·  ❌ Oxygen is produced during respiration. ✅ Oxygen is consumed in aerobic respiration; produced during photosynthesis.  ·  ❌ Food chain shows all feeding relationships. ✅ Food chain is linear; food web shows interconnected feeding relationships.

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: ❌ 90% of energy is transferred to next trophic level. ✅ Only ~10% energy transfers; ~90% lost as heat.  ·  ❌ Biomagnification decreases toxin concentration up the food chain. ✅ Biomagnification increases toxin concentration at higher trophic levels.  ·  ❌ Carbon cycle only involves plants and animals. ✅ Carbon cycle involves atmosphere, oceans, fossils, rocks, and decomposers.

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: ❌ Nitrogen fixation only occurs in bacteria. ✅ Some lightning and industrial processes (Haber) also fix nitrogen.  ·  ❌ All fungi are harmful. ✅ Many fungi are beneficial (decomposers, mycorrhizae, food, antibiotics like penicillin).  ·  ❌ Viruses are living organisms. ✅ Viruses are acellular — they cannot reproduce without a host and lack metabolism.
